Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : Tender must meet the following qualifying and other eligibility criteria stated in the Tender Documents.
1. The Tenderer shall have a minimum of 05 (Five) years of Overall experience in Software Development and related services.
2. Minimum Specific experience as web based software development of single contract(s) successfully completion within the last
03 (Three) Years, with a value of at least Tk. 9.80 Lakh
3. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities shall be Tk. 11.20 Lakh. (Certificate for proving
available liquid assets must be issued within 28 (twenty eight) days from the date of tender submission).
4. The tenderer must also have Updated Income Tax certificate (2016-2017), Trade License (2017-2018) and VAT Registration
certificate.
5. Proof of Works Completion Certificate for Software Development.
6. All others as stated in the tender documents.
